Open callTrainingProject

Fri 15 May 2026 – Sat 31 October 2026

In Solidarity - East End Stories

IN SOLIDARITY invited five local people to create short films inspired by the Battle of Cable Street.

The final films will be shown as part of the exhbition Solidarity on the Streets in October 2026.

Guest exhibition

Fri 18 September 2026 – Sat 10 October 2026

Londoni Memoirs: A Photographic and Audio-Visual Exhibition

Londoni Memoirs, a new photographic and audio-visual exhibition by Seema Khalique documenting the exodus of a generation of Bangledeshi migrants from war and their hopes of a new home here in the UK.

ExhibitionTalkFilm screening

Fri 2 October 2026 – Sat 31 October 2026

Solidarity on the Streets 

On the eve of the 90th anniversary of the Battle of Cable Street, this pop up exhibition documents East Enders’ enduring resistance to racial hatred and intolerance. 

Talk

Wed 7 October 2026 | 18:30

Battle for the East End

David Rosenberg, Nurjahan Julie Begum and Taj Ali discuss the enduring legacy of resistance to racism and fascism in the East End.

TalkFilm screening

Thu 8 October 2026 | 18:30

Cable Street: Across Borders

In conversation with Asif Shakoor, Alan Kunna and Georgie Wemyss  with a special screening of 'Limestone and Jute' by Tosin (GOKE Studio). 

TalkFilm screening

Thu 15 October 2026 | 18:30

In Solidarity: Participants Film Screening

Screening six short films inspired by the Battle of Cable Street, made by local participants as part of the East End Stories "In Solidarity" project showcase. 

 

Guest exhibition

Wed 21 October 2026 – Sat 14 November 2026

Coming soon... Hate Uprooted Diasporic Season

Jacqueline Ennis-Cole is Artist-Curator in Residence at Four Corners Gallery from 3 September until 30 November 2026, as part of the gallery's Youth X Mentoring partnership and Hate Uprooted Diasporic Season (funded with the support of Arts Council England). 

TrainingProject

Sun 1 November 2026 – Wed 30 December 2026

Camera-works

Camera-works is a series of FREE part-time courses in photography

The courses are open to Tower Hamlets residents aged under 25

We are currently recruiting for our 6-week Studio Lighting Course.
